title: Fix landing hero phone screenshot and resolve post-Internet Identity infinite loading

requirements.text: Replace the incorrect screenshot shown inside the landing-page hero phone mockup (currently showing the FunnAI Game Nest screen) with the user-selected image, and ensure it visually matches the other landing-page carousel screenshots (same crop/fit behavior and consistent phone-screen presentation).

quotes: The wrong image was used within the phone image. We shouldn’t have used the FunnAI game nest photo.
the image that will replace the FunnAI game nest photo within the phone image at the top should match one of the images from the other 4 photos in the carousel.
Let’s use this one for now

acceptanceCriteria: Landing hero phone mockup (component: frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScreenshotShowcase.tsx) no longer displays the FunnAI Game Nest screen.

The hero phone mockup displays the chosen replacement image (using the user-provided upload) and uses the same fit behavior as the carousel (object-cover / centered) so it looks consistent with the other carousel images.
Only the hero phone mockup screenshot content is changed; the phone frame, notch, sizing, and dot controls behavior remain intact.

requirements.text: Fix the Internet Identity login flow so that after a successful Internet Identity connection, the GrowInLove app opens normally instead of getting stuck on an endless loading spinner; if profile loading fails, show a clear error state with a retry action instead of an infinite spinner.

quotes: I also noticed that when trying to login to the app, after connecting with Internet identity, your brought back to the app but only a loading spinner appears.
The GrowInLove app should open normally

acceptanceCriteria: After completing Internet Identity login, the app transitions into a usable state (either main app UI or Profile Setup when no profile exists) rather than remaining on the loading screen indefinitely.
If loading the caller profile fails (e.g., query error), the UI does not remain stuck on the spinner; it renders an error message in English with a visible “Retry” action that re-attempts loading.

The loading screen in frontend/src/App.tsx only appears while initialization or profile fetch is actively in progress; it does not persist due to disabled/blocked queries (e.g., missing actor) without surfacing an actionable UI state.
Manual QA: login from the landing page header Login button and from the app-mode login screen both result in the app opening normally after authentication.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
nonGoals: Redesigning the entire landing page layout or changing copy beyond what is required to fix the issues.
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Implementing new product features unrelated to the hero screenshot replacement or the post-login loading issue.
